video_title: CHAMPIONSHIP OR BUST! Allen Iverson Reacts to LeBron James Joining the 76ers

quotes.speaker: Allen Iverson
quotes.summary_phrase: Allen Iverson expects a championship run for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Definitely championship or bust, man. That's the added piece that we needed.
quotes.quote: Definitely championship or bust, man. That's the added piece that we needed. Obviously, you put him on any team, to me, you definitely have a chance. But obviously, a whole lot of things got to go right during the season, definitely health. But as far as the leadership, the talent, the wars that he's been in, and him being familiar with every type of situation that happens on the basketball court, he just boosts the percentage of any team having a chance to win a championship and having big-time success. He's one of them ones, man. He's the king for a reason.

quotes.speaker: Allen Iverson
quotes.summary_phrase: Allen Iverson on LeBron James's legacy and the GOAT debate
quotes.excerpt: Michael Jordan was everything to me. He's the reason I play basketball.
quotes.quote: For me, it's different when you speak of who's the GOAT. Michael Jordan was everything to me. He's the reason I play basketball. The world wouldn't know Allen Iverson if it wasn't for Michael Jordan. He's the reason I played basketball. I literally wanted to be like Mike. So, it's different for me. I'm biased in that sense because I love him so much. But LeBron, I have a relationship with him. I love him. That's my little brother. I've been around those people for years and they are part of me, they are part of my heart. But the way I look at it, like Michael is always going to be the GOAT to me. And LeBron to me, I feel like if you go in the dictionary and you look up basketball player, you'll see LeBron James.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith and Allen Iverson discuss their fashion legacy
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to take some pages from your book, man.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
text_blocks.text: I'm going to go to the route of Orlando when y'all win the playoffs against Orlando with Chuck Daly coaching and you rolled up in there with the black pinstripe suit. I'll never forget that as long as I live. We're going to go that route. I'm going to start with that.

text_blocks.speaker: Allen Iverson
text_blocks.text: You know what's crazy, my teammates still joke me because I didn't wear suits. And that Versace suit that I had on was wool, and you know it was 100 degrees out there. That's right, that's right. But it looked good and the arena was air-conditioned, so I forgave you. I didn't mind.
